about_the_game:
Step beyond the veil in Harrow Gate: Ghost Dimension, a chilling survival horror experience where reality fractures and the dead do not rest. After a mysterious event opens the Harrow Gate—a rift between the living world and a spectral realm—you awaken trapped in a decaying town consumed by darkness and haunted echoes of its former inhabitants.

Every shadow hides a presence, every sound could be a warning, and every choice might be your last. Uncover lost memories, perform ancient rituals, and wield arcane technology to manipulate the realm. But beware—the longer you gaze into the Ghost Dimension, the more it gazes back, twisting your mind and reshaping your surroundings.

Survive the terror, unravel the mystery, and awaken.

Features:

  • Dynamic Haunting System: The entities adapt to your actions, learning from your fears and changing their behavior over time.

  • Psychological Horror: Experience hallucinations, distorted memories, and shifting environments that blur the line between sanity and nightmare.

  • Ritual-Based Combat: Use light, sound, and ancient sigils to weaken and banish entities—if your courage holds.
